paragraphs: R' Shimon, son of R' Aivo. See the entry R' Shimon, son of R' Abbahu.[^1]

notes.text: The same-notice heading supplies Shimon for ר״ש. Aivo and Abbahu remain different fathers, and both son relationships are explicit. All four abbreviated title components remain R'.
